method.ancestry: git merge-base --is-ancestor <sha> 80168fd5605e0c519b26f35b775bec85ef0692b1; exit 0 is an exact ancestor, exit 1 is not; any other exit fails the audit.
method.historical_nonancestors: Match the exact ref and unchanged SHA against the prior recorded reconciliation. Recheck landed PR commit ancestry, or reuse the prior identical-tree trial result only after verifying its base remains an ancestor.

limits: This is an incoming-source and exact-ancestry inventory, not a new test run or requalification of all historical implementations.
The 28 unchanged historical nonancestor refs retain prior no-op or landed-and-reconciled decisions; they are not mislabeled as exact ancestors.
The snapshot does not promise that remote refs cannot advance after the recorded cutoff. Refresh before final delivery and record any new work separately.
